accessibility.help:
Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous control (also leaves transcript text).
Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab: workspace tabs.
Editor: Ctrl+S saves project and exports; Ctrl+F focuses search; Enter applies search. F3 / Shift+F3 select the next / previous matching segment. Alt+Down / Alt+Up select segments across pages. F6 focuses transcript text.
Enter on a transcript block opens its text. F7 plays the selected segment; F8 resumes / pauses audio. Playback shortcuts are ignored in text fields and selections. Space always keeps its normal typing/button role.
Left / Right on the audio slider seek 5 seconds and preserve pause.
Windows high contrast colors are respected when enabled. Narrator support depends on Windows/Tk; full screen-reader compatibility is not verified.
Editor: Ctrl+Z undoes; Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes. One operation groups text and speaker edits until leaving a segment, searching, saving or using Undo/Redo. Batch renaming and voice assignments are separate operations. History lasts while the editor is open (200 operations / 16 MiB); subtitle settings are not part of this history.

voices.help:
Group similar voices compares existing transcript segments locally on CPU. It does not identify people or precisely separate overlapping voices or speaker changes within a segment. Short segments can remain unassigned. Review every assignment.

Select a segment and choose an existing label or type your own in Segment voice. An empty label clears that assignment. Rename voice changes every occurrence of the current label; choosing an existing name merges the labels. Undo/Redo includes these edits. Save the project to keep them.

WeSpeaker is optional (CC BY 4.0, no token). Download or repair it in Models. Source installations also need scripts/setup.ps1 -Speakers. Normal transcription needs neither this model nor its optional components. Closing this help checks availability again.
